newsitem.title: MALTA: Stocks dominate Malta exchange trading.
newsitem.headline: Stocks dominate Malta exchange trading.

text.p: Market turnover rose to 2,255,000 Maltese pounds ($5.9 million) at the weekly trading session of the Malta stock exchange on Wednesday, with traders concentrating almost exclusively on government stock.
Turnover the previous week was of 697,300 Maltese pounds.
Business was spread over 67 deals, of which 17 were in equities and 50 in fixed income securities. The share index rose by almost 2.5 points to 984.68.

Business in equities reached 11,600 pounds, with 8,801 shares transacted. Of these, 5,801 were Bank of Valletta shares traded in 13 deals at an average price of 124.5 cents per share, unchanged from the previous week.

There were three deals in Mid-Med Bank, with 2,000 shares traded at an average price of 149 cents per share, unchanged. There were no deals in Lombard Bank Malta, Middle Sea Insurance or Simonds Farsons Cisk.
In government stocks, 13 issues were traded, with turnover of 2.2 million pounds. Business was mainly in the six percent MGS 1998 (V), the six percent MGS 1998 (VI) and the 7.5 percent MGS 2011.
There were two deals in the 6.5 percent Gasan bonds 1998/00 amounting to 1,875.30 pounds.
